entry.title: Keep requests moving
entry.freshness: Review after use; verify current external facts before relying on them.
entry.limitations: A reusable prompt for an existing assistant; tool access and authority come from the actual task.

pattern.activation: several tickets or teams depend on one another, or updates leave the next owner and action unclear.

use_cases.title: Untangle a blocked request chain
use_cases.outcome: A dependency/status table and the next useful owner-specific follow-up.

links.why: Use the tracking guide to keep status evidence, dependencies and follow-ups distinct.
If the chain needs another request, identify its supported route before treating it as submitted.
